meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: civil-law tradition with corporate jurisprudence historically modeled on the Delaware General Corporation Law and a strong commercial and maritime law overlay

Panama-United Kingdom Double Taxation and Information Exchange framework, as periodically renewed by diplomatic note

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Corporations Law: Ley 32 de 26 de febrero de 1927, as amended, read with Registro Público de Panamá regulations; AML/CFT Law: Ley 23 de 27 de abril de 2015, as amended by Ley 169 de 4 de diciembre de 2020, implementing FATF Recommendations; beneficial ownership requires a central registry filing with the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) under Decreto Ejecutivo 366 de 5 de diciembre de 2018; registered agents and external counsel act as Sujetos Obligados No Financieros under Resolución UAF 01-2016 and complementary UAF rules 14-2015 and 21-2015; enhanced due diligence obligations triggered by medium-risk medical device manufacturing and cross-border wire payments.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or corporate secretary in the jurisdiction of the parent undertaking
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the competent Ministry of Foreign Affairs or designated authority; where the country of issuance is not party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention, full consular legalization through the Panama Embassy or Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney from each proposed shareholder and director to the Panamanian Resident Agent for incorporation filing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public notary in the jurisdiction of the shareholder or director, with the notarial signature certified by the Panama consular post where apostille is unavailable
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Police Clearance Certificate (Certificado de Antecedentes Penales) for each ultimate beneficial owner, director, and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police or criminal records authority of the country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter evidencing the commercial banking relationship and absence of adverse financial or compliance findings
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing financial institution in the UBO's or parent company's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized banker's signature followed by Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Signed UBO declaration and corporate organizational chart identifying all natural persons holding 25% or more of capital or exercising ultimate control
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Legal representative or corporate secretary of the direct shareholder entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization followed by Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory cumulative screening of all UBOs, directors, and authorized representatives against the United Nations Consolidated List, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, UK HM Treasury sanctions list, and the Panamanian UAF national alert list; continuous monitoring and escalation to enhanced due diligence for persons classified as politically exposed persons (PEPs) under Law 23 of 2015; negative news, adverse media, and geographic risk indicators are documented and retained for at least five years after termination of the client relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá - Online Name Reservation and Clearance System (Sistema de Certificado de Nombre) at www.registropublico.gob.pa
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Proposed corporate names may be submitted in Spanish or in any language using the Latin alphabet; non-Latin scripts must be transliterated into Latin characters. The name must be distinguishable from all registered names, must not create confusion with state or regulated entities, and must contain a corporate designation such as Sociedad Anónima or S.A.; for foreign-language denominated entities, the resident agent shall provide a sworn Spanish translation for the public deed of incorporation.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: BANCO, BANCA, FINANCIERA, SEGUROS, REASEGUROS, FONDO DE INVERSIÓN, CAPITALIZACIÓN, BOLSA DE VALORES, ARRENDAMIENTO FINANCIERO - require prior approval from the Superintendencia de Bancos or the Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores
MINISTERIO, GOBIERNO, REPÚBLICA, NACIONAL, MUNICIPIO, POLICÍA, CORTE, TRIBUNAL, PRESIDENCIA - proprietary or official state designations prohibited without specific legal authorization
CRUZ ROJA, CRESCENTE ROJO, INTERPOL, NACIONES UNIDAS, OEA, UNION EUROPEA - protected national and international emblems
HOSPITAL, CLÍNICA, MÉDICO, FARMACÉUTICO, FARMACIA, ORTOPÉDICO, SALUD - health-related tokens triggering special review by the Ministry of Health (MINSA) before name clearance is granted
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Name reservation certificates are valid for 30 calendar days and are not extendable; after expiry, the applicant must submit a new certificate request. Upon rejection, the applicant may file a written reconsideration (recurso de reconsideración) with the Registro Público de Panamá within 5 working days of the refusal, attaching legal arguments and the revised name; a subsidium appeal (recurso de apelación) lies to the hierarchical body of the Registro Público within 5 further working days, after which the aggrieved party may seek judicial review before the Sala Tercera de lo Contencioso Administrativo of the Corte Suprema de Justicia.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual-office arrangement does not satisfy the statutory registered-office requirement; the Sociedad Anónima must be registered at the physical address of its licensed Panamanian resident agent for service of process. For the ISIC 3250 orthopedic implant manufacturer, production may remain offshore without attracting Panamanian source income, but the company must hold verifiable substance, including a local registered agency, accounting records, and a bank account, where treaty or tax-residence benefits are sought.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk of 10-15% in the first fiscal year: the UAF and the Superintendencia de Sujetos No Financieros may conduct unannounced inspections of the resident agent's client files, and a physical inspection of the registered office of a newly formed S.A. is possible but unlikely where operations are conducted entirely abroad through wire transfers and letters of credit.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley No. 32 de 1927 (Sociedades Anónimas), as amended; Articles 2, 4, 8, 11 and 47 governing incorporation, capital, corporate books, registered agent and statutory records; supplemented by the Regulations of the Registro Público (Acuerdo No. 9 de 2019) and the AML rulebook of Ley No. 23 de 2015.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (Public Registry of Panama) — Dirección General de Registro, Sección de Personas Jurídicas / Sección Mercantil
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública No. ____ (Pacto Social y Estatutos de la Sociedad Anónima), protocolized before a Panamanian Notary and inscribed in the Public Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under Ley No. 32 de 1927; the charter fixes authorized capital of USD 100,000, divided into 100,000 common shares of USD 1.00 par value each. Panama imposes no legal escrow deposit for the capital; however, under the AML rules of Ley No. 23 de 2015 the initial capital remittance must be documented through a licensed Panamanian bank and the deposit certificate retained as evidence of paid-up capital for the banking KYC file.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The Board of Directors, having quorum, unanimously adopts: 1. Share Subscription. The subscription of 100,000 common shares, par value USD 1.00, is ratified and recorded in the Share Register. 2. Registered Office. The registered office is fixed at Suite 400, Avenida Samuel Lewis, Panama City, and the resident agent is confirmed. 3. Officers. [A], [B], and [C] are elected President, Secretary, and Treasurer until successors are chosen. 4. Authorizations. The President and Secretary are jointly authorized to open bank accounts, sign leases, and file regulatory registrations. 5. Instructions. Counsel is directed to complete statutory filings and obtain operating licenses.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Ventanilla Única de Trámites / electronic name-search portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a name-reservation application listing up to three alternative corporate names in the format '___________, S.A.', each evidencing the business purpose of medical device manufacturing. The Registry performs a phonetic and exact-match search against the mercantile index; upon clearance, a Certificado de Disponibilidad de Nombre is issued, valid for 30 days, within which the charter must be presented.
required_dossiers: Scanned identification of the subscribing incorporator
Certificate of name search payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is refused due to identity or similarity with an existing registration, resubmit using the alternate names, modify the name with a distinguishing sign, or file a written re-consideration request with the Registro Público within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of the Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública del Circuito de Panamá (Notary of the First Judicial Circuit of Panama)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare and finalize the Escritura Pública containing the corporate purpose (including the manufacture of titanium orthopedic implants by electron-beam additive manufacturing), authorized capital, share classes, perpetual duration, registered office clause, resident-agent appointment and board powers. The subscriber(s) execute the instrument before the Notary, who protocolizes the deed in the protocol book and issues certified first-copy excerpts. Payment of national stamp duties and notarial fees is made at the notary's office.
required_dossiers: Passport or national ID of each founding subscriber
Written acceptance of the resident agent
Payment of notarial and stamp fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Notary objects to a clause (e.g., overly broad purpose or defective capital clause), amend the text by an addendum and re-execute the deed before the same Notary; a duplicate original is issued without repealing the notarization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscription of the Charter in the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección de Personas Jurídicas
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the protocolized Escritura Pública with the cover sheet (solicitud de inscripción), pay the inscription tariff, and present the name certificate and stamped payment receipt. The Registry examiners verify compliance with Ley No. 32 de 1927, issue a folio real, and return the inscribed certificate. This step must be completed within the 30-day validity of the name certificate.
required_dossiers: Registered cover sheet / application for inscription
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a reparo (examiner deficiency note) is issued, cure the cited defects within ten business days by presenting corrected pages or a clarification letter; request one formal extension if additional time is needed; if the Registry denies inscription, appeal through the hierarchy of the Registro Público.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of Corporate Books and Obtain Certified Excerpts
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — División de Anotación de Libros / Customer Service Desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After inscription, present the Share Register (Libro de Registro de Acciones) and the Minutes Book (Libro de Actas de la Asamblea y de la Junta Directiva) for annotation by the Registry, which stamps and authorizes the first and last pages. Simultaneously, obtain certified copies of the Ficha Registral (corporate extract) and the fully inscribed charter, which serve as the official corporate kit for banks and authorities.
required_dossiers: Share register book (blank ledger prepared per registry format)
Ficha Registral application / certified copy request form
Payment receipt of book annotation fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the book format is rejected for non-compliance with the registry's physical security requirements, replace the ledger with a registry-approved edition and reapply; if the extract contains discrepancies, file a correction request with supporting certified documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration — Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas — Virtual Office for Taxpayers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the corporation as a taxpayer in the RUC system via the DGI virtual office or at the corresponding taxpayer service center, selecting 'industrial activity — manufacture of medical devices'. The RUC certificate is required prior to import customs operations (including electron-beam equipment) and for invoicing. After obtaining the RUC, a decisive tax percentage is assigned and fiscal domicile is recorded.
required_dossiers: RUC application signed by the legal representative
Identification of the President and Secretary
Evidence of paid capital / bank certificate (if available)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUC application is suspended or queried for inconsistent economic activity, rectify the business code (ISIC 3250), upload corrected supporting documents, or attend the taxpayer service center for reassignment of the tax profile.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Corporate Bank Account and Paid-in Capital Deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá — Licensed commercial bank (e.g., Banco Nacional de Panamá or a private universal bank)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Deliver the certified corporate kit to the bank of choice, complete the KYC/AML file required by Ley No. 23 de 2015 and the due-diligence rulebooks of the Superintendencia de Bancos, execute the board resolution authorizing account opening, and effect the initial deposit of working capital by wire transfer or cash. Obtain the deposit certificate as proof of paid-up capital for the corporate records.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the inscribed Escritura Pública
Original Board Resolution appointing officers and authorizing banking operations
Passport / ID and address proof of the beneficial owner and signatories
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional KYC information, supplement the file with an organizational chart, commercial references and a source-of-funds declaration; if the initial deposit is rejected due to sanctions screening, provide clarifying transactional details or select an alternative licensed bank.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Operation Notice — Aviso de Operación
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipio de Panamá — Dirección de Rentas Municipales / Ventanilla de Aviso de Operación
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Aviso de Operación application for the industrial establishment at the registered production address, declaring the estimated gross annual income and the ISIC 3250 business line. The Municipality issues the municipal operating notice and assesses the proportional municipal tax for the opening year. The production premises are subject to municipal inspection to confirm zoning and occupancy.
required_dossiers: Lease contract or property title of the plant premises
Fire safety letter from the Benemérito Cuerpo de Bomberos
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Municipality objects for zoning incompatibility, apply for a land-use certificate (certificado de uso de suelo) from the appropriate district office and attach it to the file; unpaid municipal rates, if challenged, can be settled under a payment agreement.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Employer Registration — Caja de Seguro Social (CSS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Caja de Seguro Social — Dirección Nacional de Ingresos / Employer Registration Window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the corporation as an employer in the CSS payroll system using the RUC and the Ficha Registral, provide the legal representative's appointment, declare the first payroll, and obtain the employer registration number. This step is mandatory before hiring any staff for the manufacturing plant and is integrated later with the mandatory occupational risk insurance filing.
required_dossiers: Appointment records of the President / Secretary
Bank account certificate for payroll payments
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the CSS file is rejected for employer data inconsistency, correct the RUC details and resubmit; if the payroll structure exceeds filing thresholds, submit a rectification statement; unresolved CSS queries are resolved through the Dirección Nacional de Ingresos customer service.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Salud (MINSA) — Dirección Nacional de Farmacia y Drogas (DNFD), in coordination with the Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) — Dirección General de Industrias for the Registro Industrial Nacional
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia Sanitaria de Funcionamiento para Establecimiento Fabricante de Dispositivos Médicos (Clase II, per Decreto Ejecutivo No. 40 de 2017), complemented by the Certificado de Inscripción en el Registro Industrial Nacional (MICI) and the municipal Aviso de Operación

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) — Dirección de Verificación del Desempeño Ambiental (formerly ANAM)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Categoría II — Informe de Impacto Ambiental under Ley No. 41 de 1998 and Decreto Ejecutivo No. 123 de 2009; mandatory follow-up monitoring; escalation to Categoría III (full Estudio de Impacto Ambiental) required when installed energy exceeds 5 MW, plant footprint exceeds 3,000 m², or the facility is located in an environmentally protected zone.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with national industrial wastewater discharge limits (BOD5 ≤ 100 mg/L, COD ≤ 200 mg/L, TSS ≤ 50 mg/L, pH 6-9, and oil/grease ≤ 30 mg/L) for the cooling and cleaning loops; occupational air and VOC exposure limits under MITRADEL and CSS hygiene standards; control of electron-beam chamber off-gas (argon management), titanium particulate capture via HEPA filtration, and hazardous waste manifests for scrap and spent abrasives per the hazardous-waste regime of Ley No. 1 de 1994, with the quality system benchmarked to ISO 13485.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety certification of the plant from the Benemérito Cuerpo de Bomberos de la República de Panamá; structural load inspection and occupancy certificate from the Ministerio de Vivienda y Ordenamiento Territorial (MIVIOT); workplace health-and-safety clearance from the Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral (MITRADEL) and the Caja de Seguro Social; and an emergency preparedness plan filed with SINAPROC.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF); online taxpayer portal 'DGI en Línea' at https://www.dgi.gob.pa (SISTEMA e-Tax registration and filing); electronic invoicing operated through the DGI Facturación Electrónica platform; customs export declarations processed via SUCA (Sistema Único de Códigos Aduaneros) of the Dirección General de Aduanas, with corporate registration at the Registro Público de Panamá.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1 – Incorporate the S.A. by notarial Escritura Pública and register it in the Registro Público to obtain the Folio Electrónico/Personería Jurídica. Step 2 – Appoint a resident fiscal agent (mandatory for non-resident shareholders under Law 52 of 2016) and a resident legal representative with sufficient powers. Step 3 – File the Aviso de Operación (business commencement notice) in the Ventanilla Única/Registro Público within the statutory period. Step 4 – Register with the DGI by submitting the Formulario Único de Registro (FUR), the registered deed, fiscal-agent acceptance letter, corporate books, IDs of the representative/shareholders, and proof of registered address; obtain the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes) certificate, which consolidates ISR, ITBMS, and dividend tax registration. Step 5 – If annual gross income will not exceed B/. 230,000, elect the Régimen Simplificado (Law 66 of 2017); otherwise operate in the Régimen General. Step 6 – Obtain a DGI-compliant digital signature certificate (.p12) from an authorized certification authority for e-filing and e-invoicing. Step 7 – Register as exporter (RUC exporter status) in SUCA for future customs export declarations. Estimated processing: 5–10 business days for RUC, plus 5–15 business days for customs and e-invoicing activation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation / Territorial_Scope: the S.A. is a resident stock corporation taxed at the entity level (25% corporate income tax) exclusively on Panamanian-source income; foreign-source income is outside the Panamanian tax base; no pass-through or fiscally-transparent election exists for S.A. entities.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama has no US-style check-the-box or elective entity-classification regime; all S.A. entities are per se taxpaying corporations. Available elections for an active export manufacturer: (a) Régimen Simplificado (Law 66 of 2017) – election to pay a single quarterly tax replacing ISR and ITBMS when annual gross income ≤ B/. 230,000; (b) SEM multinational-headquarters regime (Law 41 of 2007) – 5% CIT election for qualifying regional service operations; (c) special customs/tax free-zone regimes (e.g., Colon Free Zone, Panamá Pacífico) – election to operate under 0% ITBMS and income-tax exemptions for zone sales/exports; (d) City of Knowledge incentives for science/technology tenants; (e) CAIR accelerated inflation adjustment (Art. 705-A Código Fiscal) – election to adjust inventories and fixed-asset costs faster than book depreciation; (f) dividend withholding election – quarterly provisional dividend tax method (5%) versus 10% final withholding on declared distributions. Hybrid-mismatch elections are not available; Panama's CFC rules (Law 254 of 2021) and participation-exemption regime apply mandatorily.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS – Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Mecanizados y Servicios (Panamanian VAT), levied by the DGI on sales of movable goods, onerous services, importation, and construction; exports of goods are zero-rated.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: B/. 230,000 (Balboas at 1:1 USD) of annual gross income – taxpayers up to this threshold may elect the Simplified Regime (single quarterly payment, no separate ITBMS filing); taxpayers above the threshold must register and file monthly ITBMS. DGI administrative practice additionally applies a B/. 36,000 annual turnover de minimis for mandatory ITBMS registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: DGI electronic invoicing (Facturación Electrónica) is mandatory for ITBMS contributors by phased implementation. Invoices and equivalent documents must be sent in XML to the DGI clearance platform via web-service API (large/medium taxpayers) or the free web portal (small taxpayers); the platform validates the digital certificate (.p12 from an authorized CA), verifies the RUC status, and returns in real time a four-digit 'código de aceptación' (acceptance code) or a rejection/reason code. Accepted documents carry a unique 'número de comprobante' and a QR verification code printed on the customer copy. Offline issuance is tolerated for maximum 48 hours; such documents must be pre-generated with a contingency QR and transmitted before the deadline. No physical stamping or paper fiscal seals are required; only DGI-accepted e-invoices generate deductible input-credit.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Sales of manufactured goods (e.g., porous titanium hip-joint implants) qualify for 0% ITBMS when: (i) goods leave Panamanian customs territory under a definitive export declaration (DUA) filed in SUCA; (ii) the seller holds active RUC/exporter status with the DGI; (iii) the purchaser is non-resident and title/risk passes outside Panama; and (iv) export proceeds are received through the banking system. Input ITBMS incurred on production inputs (titanium powder, electron-beam consumables, utilities, packaging) is creditable against the 0% output rate, and net excess credits are refundable (reintegro) or offsettable after DGI fiscal review. Services rendered to non-domiciled clients are zero-rated only when the services are effectively utilized abroad; goods destined for national free zones or re-delivered to the domestic market do not qualify.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DUA – Declaración Única Aduanera) validated in SUCA and accepted by the Dirección General de Aduanas
Bill of Lading (ocean) or Air Waybill (air) evidencing physical shipment from Panama to the foreign purchaser
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT MT103 bank credit confirmation evidencing receipt of export proceeds within the 180-day repatriation window
Commercial export invoice (0% ITBMS rate stated), packing list, and certificate of origin (if preferential treatment claimed)
DGI exporter-registry certificate and prior authorized-export documentation archived for audit
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI export audits (fiscalización) reconcile SUCA customs exit data against ITBMS filings, production capacity, and banking records; physical inspection of the manufacturing plant is routine for high-value credits. Failure to bank export proceeds within 180 days or mismatched customs/payment evidence triggers administrative reassessment of 7% output VAT on the full export invoice, monthly late-payment interest (1.5% per month under Art. 730 Código Fiscal), a 25% surcharge on the assessed tax, and fines of 50%–200% of the evaded amount. Fraudulent zero-rating (forged bills of lading, fictitious exports, back-to-back sham transactions) is a criminal tax offense under the Panamanian criminal-tax regime carrying 2–5 years' imprisonment, increased to 6–10 years when false documents or organized schemes are used; the exporter registry may be suspended up to two years and all previously refunded input credits are clawed back with interest. The statute of limitations for assessment is six fiscal years, extended to ten years in cases of fraudulent conduct.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Panama has no central bank. Banking supervision is exercised solely by the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP). Monetary and financial policy coordination is handled by the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF). The US Dollar is the only legal tender with unlimited convertibility; the Balboa is a nominal coinage unit only. There is no foreign exchange administration separate from the SBP.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility. Because Panama formally dollarized in 1904, there is no national fiat currency and therefore no capital or current account convertibility restrictions. Both capital and operating transactions are freely convertible. Profit remittance by foreign-owned S.A. entities is subject to Panama's territorial dividend tax (typically 5% once Panamanian-source profits have been taxed at entity level), but there are no separate exchange-control approvals, no remarkable remittance hurdles, and no limitation on repatriation of liquidation proceeds.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panama does not impose any statutory timeline, mandatory conversion ratio, or surrender obligation on export proceeds. An exporter such as the titanium orthopedic implant manufacturer may retain all foreign currency earnings in any authorized SBP-licensed bank, whether offshore or domestic, without reporting to any exchange-control body. Customs declarations must accurately value goods, but no FX surrender is required.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Panama has not enacted a distinct Electronic Money Institution (EMI) license analog for cross-border deposit-taking. Offshore digital EMIs generally cannot offer a Panamanian-local S.A. a compliant corporate account unless they have a local SBP-licensed banking partner. An S.A. may use a fintech for payment initiation or settlement only when the underlying corporate account is maintained at an SBP-supervised commercial bank. Standalone EMIs without a Panama banking license are legally prohibited from receiving deposits from domestic entities.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of the registered agent and beneficial owners is generally mandated for medium-risk corporate clients. Most tier-1 banks require the S.A. legal representative and each ultimate beneficial owner with 10% or more ownership to appear in person before a bank officer or a Panamanian notary. Remote online onboarding is permitted only in limited cases where the bank uses SBP-approved video KYC with geo-verification, apostilled entity documents, and an introductory bank reference; however, a final in-person interview at the branch (or at a Panamanian consulate) remains the norm for manufacturing companies with cross-border trade flows.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque corporate chain or nominee shareholders/directors in a Panama S.A. — viewed as a classic shell risk
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide an organizational chart detailing chain from UBO to entity; certified copies of passports and electricity bills for all UBOs; Pact-to-merger or trust agreement (where applicable); notarized 'Declaración de Dueño Beneficiario' with the registered agent; certified public registry record (Ficha) demonstrating continuous good standing; sworn statement of legitimate business purpose for titanium implant manufacturing and medical device export.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Medical device industry margins or import/export transaction mismatches (over-invoicing, side letters, third-party payment engines)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide full supply chain documentation: signed purchase orders, ISO 13485 certificate, EU MDR/FDA registration where applicable, CE certificate for titanium 3D printed implants; 3-way matching of commercial invoice, Bill of Lading (Airway Bill), and customs declaration; independent conformity assessment; explanation of commercial rationale for discounts; beneficiary bank details; letter confirming the device distribution agreement with licensed distributors.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual cross-border settlement: payments from third-party freight forwarders, trading hubs, or high-risk countries
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Execute a detailed distribution or sales contract that names the ultimate consignee and stepped intermediaries; include a bank reference letter from the counterparty bank; provide UBO clearance and sanctions screening for all parties; if technically feasible, furnish quality inspection certificates and serial numbers for each implant consignment; the company must present the end-user medical institution license or import permit and a sworn undertaking confirming no money laundering or terrorist financing nexus.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injections from a parent company or non-resident shareholder are settled only through high-value SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 if interbank) to the S.A. operational account. The payment narrative must clearly state 'Capital contribution under S.A. Shareholder Resolution' or 'Shareholder loan under private pact'. A local bank will require the certified board/shareholders resolution, updated public registry (Ficha), passport copies of signatories, and a signed affidavit. No exchange-control approval is needed; however, the bank may request a letter of explanation for any capital injection exceeding USD 1.5 million, plus proof of economic substance in Panama (payroll, physical office, or storage evidence) to satisfy SBP regulations.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlement to suppliers of titanium alloy powder, electron beam 3D printers, and surface finishing consumables is executed via (i) SWIFT MT103 payment orders for open-account purchases, and (ii) Commercial Letters of Credit issued per ICC UCP 600 (documentary credit transmitted by MT700) for high-value or recurring purchase orders. Typical sanitization requires full commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, quality certificates conforming to ASTM F1472 or ISO 5832-3, and transportation documents. For intra-Panama disbursements, the local ACH is usable, but the default for cross-border is SWIFT.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD-denominated treasury operations only — Panama's full dollarization eliminates USD-to-local-currency FX risk and thus does not require USD hedging.
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) executed on EUR/CNY/CLP pairs with a Panamanian licensed bank or through a local broker in connection with export receivables.
Cross-currency interest rate swaps solely for project finance debt underpinned by USD floating-rate debt and fixed-rate supply contracts.
FX options embedded in a corporate master derivative agreement (only with SBP-licensed counterparties and subject to internal board approval).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Franchise Tax and Sworn Capital Statement (Impuesto de Anualidad / Declaración Jurada de Capital Suscrito y Pagado)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance, Panama
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually during the first quarter of the calendar year (January 1 - March 31); standard fee applies for authorized capital up to USD 10,000.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment triggers statutory surcharge, monthly interest, and loss of tax clearance (Paz y Salvo); three consecutive unpaid annual fees expose the S.A. to administrative strike-off and cancellation in the Public Registry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaración Jurada de Impuesto sobre la Renta)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance, Panama
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For calendar-year companies, on or before March 31 of the following year; for companies with off-calendar fiscal years, within three months after fiscal year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing is subject to Fiscal Code fines, surcharges, and monthly interest on any tax due; persistent delinquency blocks issuance of Paz y Salvo and leads to registry restrictions and strike-off proceedings.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent audit by a Panamanian certified public accountant is mandatory when gross annual income or total assets exceed USD 3,000,000; companies below this threshold are generally not required to present audited financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS (full International Financial Reporting Standards) or IFRS for SMEs, as adopted by the Panama Accounting Technical Board; tax-basis records must be maintained in accordance with the Panamanian Fiscal Code.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Law 52 of 2016, the S.A. must maintain an internal Ultimate Beneficial Owner register identifying any natural person owning or controlling 10% or more of the shares or control rights; the register must be updated within 30 days of any share transfer or UBO change, and the resident agent reviews and confirms the UBO schedule annually during the corporate maintenance cycle. No public UBO filing is required, but the register must be made available to DGI and the Financial Analysis Unit (UAF) on request.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Directors (Libro de Registro de Directores)
Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea y Directores)
Ultimate Beneficial Owner Register (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% on Panama-source taxable income of Sociedad Anónima; foreign-source income is excluded under territorial taxation.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No blanket manufacturing holiday. Reductions/exemptions available under: SEM/Multinational Headquarters Regime (effective 5%), Panama Pacifico SEZ and Colon Free Zone (up to 100% exemption for qualifying operations), and statutory R&D/export training credits. An S.A. without a license remains taxable at 25%.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 202 - Declaración Anual de Renta (Panama annual income tax return). Filed via the DGI e-tax portal (Dirección General de Ingresos / Declaración Electrónica Tributaria - DET).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; quarterly advance-payment declarations are separate and do not replace the Form 202 filing.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three months after fiscal year-end; calendar-year taxpayers must file no later than 31 March unless DGI grants a formal extension.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax identification number (RUC), exact legal name of the Sociedad Anónima, date of incorporation, fiscal year end and registered address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the RUC issued to the Panama entity; foreign shareholders do not obtain a Panama RUC, but the company must list them in the beneficial ownership schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total revenue, net of returns and discounts, from the sale of titanium orthopedic implants and related services attributable to Panamanian economic activities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include only Panama-source revenue. Revenue from devices sold outside Panama, e.g. export sales with title transfer outside Panama, is excluded; maintain bills of lading and contracts.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of goods sold, raw titanium powder, electron-beam melting electricity, employee wages, depreciation, bank charges, TRA/insurance and technical fees supporting the production activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Costs must be incurred for Panamanian operations, evidenced by supplier invoices, and be arm's length if purchased from foreign related parties; head-office allocations are generally non-deductible unless invoiced.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net operating loss from prior tax years available to offset current taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use only losses from Panamanian-source activities; maximum carryforward is five years. Foreign parent losses are not eligible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Adjusted Panama-source profit computed after cost deductions, TP adjustments, NOL utilization and any special zone/SEZ deductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If a DTA or SEZ exemption is claimed, state the exempt amount separately, but all floating allowances must trace to a DGI certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 38 (Tax rate and final tax payable)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Application of 25% corporate income tax rate, less advance payments (Form 205), prepaid dividend tax and withholding credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No net tax at lower treaty rate unless the non-resident parent supplies a valid tax residence certificate (TRC) and the payer has made the required DTA withholding filings.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Disclosure of dividends, interest and royalties remitted to non-resident shareholders/related parties, with treaty-based withholding reductions claimed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach OECD-compliant TRC, beneficial ownership declaration, and confirm payment destination; DGI may deny relief for shell recipients without substance.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 5% of the tax due per month (or fraction) up to 50%, plus current interest and monthly surcharge; minimum administrative fines B/.200-B/.1,000 on nil returns; serious false declarations carry criminal fraud penalties and disgorgement of tax credits. Non-filing triggers estimated assessment based on the DGI's own database.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory dividend withholding on distributions from Panama-source profits; 5% reduced rate for SEM/Multinational Headquarters entities; 0% if dividends are sourced from documented foreign-source exempt profits.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke DTA relief: (1) obtain a current TRC from the shareholder's jurisdiction; (2) provide the Panama payer with a beneficial ownership declaration; (3) submit a DTA relief notice/electronic application to DGI before remittance; (4) obtain DGI confirmation or apply for a refund within three years; (5) attach the approved schedule to Form 202. Relief is denied to entities lacking economic substance or mere booking offices.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic withholding: 12.5% on royalties paid for technology, trademark or technical services used in Panama; 12.5% on interest from loans beneficially used in Panama; DTA protocols can reduce royalty/interest rates to 0%-10%. Non-residents without form or treaty enjoy no exemption unless a specific territorial rule applies.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: B/. 1,500,000 (Balboa/USD at par) in annual aggregate related-party transactions; taxpayers below threshold must still perform a functional analysis if requested, and documented companies must file the DGI TP informative declaration.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama's Economic Substance Regulations (Law 70 of 2019) require tax-resident entities carrying on relevant activities to prove premises, employees, board management and core income-generating activity in Panama. For an orthopedic-implant manufacturer, substance is presumed if DGI files show real production, payroll and local factory costs; artificial 'mailbox' S.A.s or just-in-time booking through shell suppliers fail ESR and can be deregistered.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Willful filing of Form 202 with understated Panama-source revenue, fabricated annuity/intercompany invoices, or structured cash deposits through offshore accounts to hide audit certificates.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal tax fraud (Ley 76 de 2019, Código Fiscal): fine up to twice the tax evaded, disgorgement of deductions, asset seizure and imprisonment from two to eight years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, legal representatives and tax advisers who sign false returns are jointly liable for civil restitution; travel bans, passport withholding, disqualification from public contracts, and criminal conviction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using an S.A. with no employees, no physical factory, no local board decisions, and no substance while claiming SEM or treaty relief on royalties/dividends; registering beneficial owners through nominees in the Public Registry.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR fines under Law 70/2019 up to USD 1,000,000 or 2% of turnover, deregistration/disbarment of the company, nullity of tax benefits, and recalculation of 12.5% withholding on payments.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for taxes reassessed if the corporate veil is pierced; civil claims can attach personal assets; commercial interdiction and prohibitions from serving on any Panama company.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Structuring SWIFT wire payments through unregulated intermediaries, using shell customers for 'titanium implant' invoices with no deliveries, or receiving commissions named to conceal bribery of foreign hospital procurement officials.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Money-laundering penalties: fines up to USD 5 million or 5% of assets; forfeiture of instrumentalities; imprisonment from 5 to 15 years under the Penal Code and AML Law, plus revocation of corporate license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal criminal liability applies to officers and beneficial owners who control accounts; civil restitution orders, travel bans, and extradition exposure for predicate foreign corruption.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intercompany sale of porous titanium hip implants at manipulated margins, unviewed management fees to a related Hong Kong service company, and refusal to produce Master File/Local File when connected transactions exceed B/. 1.5 million.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: TP non-compliance: 2% penalty on the value of unreported controlled transactions, automatic upward profit adjustment at 25%, monthly interest from the assessment date, and disallowance of related-party expense deductions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Legal representatives who fail to file the TP informative return are personally liable for fines; operating directors may face civil liability for unauthorized dividend distributions based on wrong TP results.
